description:
Reads UBL 2.1 invoices and credit notes and UN/CEFACT CII D16B invoices into ESJ
    documents, and writes an ESJ document back as the XR representation. The syntax
    knowledge is not this module's: the documents are first transformed into the semantic
    XR representation by the stylesheets of the KoSIT XRechnung visualization, and only the
    business term identifiers of that representation are mapped to semantic paths.
